review.why: Focused loading, cleaning, grouping and validated joins with pandas 3 compatibility guidance.
review.summary: Prepare tabular data with explicit types, validated joins, pandas 3 assignment and resampling patterns, and Parquet export. This community-maintained reference complements the analysis workflow; runtime verification remains incomplete.
cautions: Requires compatible Python/pandas; Parquet needs pyarrow
Do not replace unknown amounts with zero without a business rule
Choose join cardinality for the actual data; runtime verification is incomplete
